event.greeting.reason: 屠妖节 is not the standard term for Deepavali in Singapore; 深谷利 is commonly used.

event.intro.english: Learn the tricks scammers use, then take the quiz.
event.intro.draft: 了解骗子的伎俩，然后参加问答。
event.intro.back: Understand scammers' tricks, then participate in quiz.

event.souvenirNote.english: Get all answers correct and show your QR code to an MOM officer for a souvenir. First 500 only!

event.souvenirNote.back: After all answers correct, show your QR code to MOM officer, can get souvenir. Only first 500!

ui.afterPartial.english: Review the answers, then try again.

ui.unsure.suggestion: 不确定？请拨打 ScamShield 热线

ui.allCorrectMsg.english: Show this QR code to an MOM officer for your souvenir.

learn[3].chat.lines[0].back: Good news! Your work permit has been approved.

learn[3].chat.lines[1].draft: 今天汇$800来确认您的工作。
learn[3].chat.lines[1].back: Today transfer $800 to confirm your job.

learn[3].todo[1].english: Asking you to pay first is a common job scam sign. Scammers can fake letters and copy licence numbers.
learn[3].todo[1].draft: 要您先付钱是工作诈骗的常见迹象。骗子可以伪造信件，盗用执照号码。

learn[4].tagline.english: Scammers ask for the code sent to your phone.
learn[4].tagline.draft: 骗子向您索取发到您手机的验证码。
learn[4].tagline.back: Scammers ask for the verification code sent to your phone.
learn[4].tagline.suggestion: 骗子要您手机收到的验证码。
learn[4].tagline.reason: 索取 is formal; 要 is more everyday. 发到您手机的 -> 手机收到的 is more natural.

learn[4].chat.lines[0].english: Sorry, I sent a code to your phone by mistake.
learn[4].chat.lines[0].draft: 不好意思，我不小心把验证码发到您的手机了。
learn[4].chat.lines[0].back: Sorry, I accidentally sent the verification code to your phone.
learn[4].chat.lines[0].suggestion: 不好意思，我不小心把验证码发给您手机了。
learn[4].chat.lines[0].reason: 发到 -> 发给 is more natural for sending a code.

learn[4].chat.lines[1].english: Please send me the 6-digit code. Quick!
learn[4].chat.lines[1].draft: 请把那个6位数的验证码发给我。快！
learn[4].chat.lines[1].back: Please send me that 6-digit verification code. Quick!
learn[4].chat.lines[1].suggestion: 请发给我6位数验证码。快！
learn[4].chat.lines[1].reason: 那个6位数的 -> 6位数 is shorter and more natural. 请把 -> 请发给 is clearer.

learn[4].flags[0].label.english: Asks for your OTP and rushes you
learn[4].flags[0].label.back: Asks for your OTP and also urges you
learn[4].flags[0].label.reason: 索取 is formal; 要 is everyday. 催促您 is formal; 催你 is casual.

learn[4].todo[0].english: Never share your OTP (the code sent to your phone) with anyone.
learn[4].todo[0].draft: 绝不要把您的OTP（发到您手机的验证码）告诉任何人。
learn[4].todo[0].back: Never tell anyone your OTP (the verification code sent to your phone).
learn[4].todo[0].suggestion: 绝不要把您的OTP（手机收到的验证码）告诉任何人。
learn[4].todo[0].reason: 发到您手机的 -> 手机收到的 is more natural.

learn[4].todo[1].english: Remember ACT: ADD the ScamShield app, CHECK with 1799, TELL family and friends.
learn[4].todo[1].draft: 记住ACT：ADD 安装ScamShield应用，CHECK 拨打1799查证，TELL 告诉家人和朋友。

learn[4].todo[1].reason: ADD 安装ScamShield应用 -> ADD ScamShield app matches English. 查证 is formal; 查一下 is everyday.

quiz[0].msg.bubbles[0][1].t.english: you have an unpaid work permit fine of $350.

quiz[0].msg.bubbles[0][1].t.back: You have a $350 work permit fine not yet paid.

quiz[0].msg.bubbles[0][1].t.reason: 尚未缴付 is formal; 还没交 is everyday.

quiz[0].msg.bubbles[1][0].t.reason: 缴付 is formal; 付款 is everyday. 在以下 -> 在下面的 is more natural.

quiz[0].msg.bubbles[1][2].t.english: or reply with your bank login.

quiz[0].msg.bubbles[1][2].t.reason: 或 is formal; 或者 is everyday. 资料 is formal; 信息 is more natural.

quiz[0].explain.english: Government SMSes come from "gov.sg". Real MOM addresses end with ".mom.gov.sg". The Government never asks for your bank login by SMS. Unsure? Call 1799.
quiz[0].explain.draft: 政府短信来自"gov.sg"。MOM的真实网址以".mom.gov.sg"结尾。政府绝不会通过短信索取您的银行登录资料。不确定？请拨打1799。

quiz[0].explain.suggestion: 政府短信来自"gov.sg"。MOM的真实网址以".mom.gov.sg"结尾。政府绝不会通过短信要您的银行登录信息。不确定的话？打1799。
quiz[0].explain.reason: 索取 is formal; 要 is everyday. 不确定？ -> 不确定的话？ is more natural. 请拨打 -> 打 is shorter.

quiz[1].cards[0].text.back: Please buy rice on the way home. Thank you!
